name: application-funnel-chart
title: Funnel Chart
description: Stepped conversion visualization with per-stage counts and drop-off percentages computed from real data, for signup, checkout, or onboarding funnels.
useWhen: Visualizing how a cohort narrows across sequential stages (e.g. visited → signed up → verified → converted).
You want the drop-off percentage between each stage computed automatically from the counts, not hand-typed.
A simple, label-forward stacked-bar funnel is enough — no need for interactive drill-down or segment breakdowns.
avoidWhen: Stages aren't sequential/narrowing — use a bar chart or the charts component instead.
You need per-segment comparison within a funnel (e.g. by channel) — this variant shows one funnel at a time.
The dataset has only two points — a stat-tile delta is simpler than a multi-stage funnel.
responsiveBehavior: The card and its bars are fluid width; bars scale proportionally to the first stage's value regardless of container width.
accessibility: Each stage bar carries role='img' with an aria-label stating the stage name, count, and drop-off percentage together, since the bar's width alone doesn't convey exact values to screen readers.
Drop-off is shown as both a percentage label and a shorter bar, not color alone.
Stage counts use toLocaleString for readable grouping (e.g. 12,400) rather than raw unformatted numbers.

variants.title: Funnel chart
variants.description: Four-stage signup funnel with counts and per-stage drop-off percentages, on a light surface.
accessibility: Bar width is supplementary; the count and drop-off text carry the precise values.

variants.title: Funnel chart (Dark)
variants.description: Four-stage signup funnel with counts and drop-off percentages, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Bar and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
